Reviewer recommends rejection: All checked facts are supported by the sources. Reject for formatting: the summary and FAQ answers contain [s:id] citation tags, which belong only in the body. Remove those tags and resubmit.

claims.claim: Born 22 July 1998 in Alella, Spain
claims.note: LaLiga gives 22/07/1998 and 'native Alella'; FotMob gives 22 July 1998 and Spain.

claims.claim: Age 28 as of 26 October 2026
claims.note: Neither page states an age. The figure is arithmetic from the confirmed birth date and is correct.

claims.claim: Nationality Spain; 35 caps for Spain
claims.note: FotMob lists Spain and 35 senior appearances. The Analyst lists 35 games, 1 goal, 4 assists, with no as-of date, as the article already notes.

claims.claim: Futsal in Alella from age four; Espanyol trial via father Oscar; Barcelona scouts Guillermo Amor and Albert Puig after CF Damm match; Camp Nou in 2012; role models David Luiz and Carles Puyol
claims.note: All stated on the LaLiga page.

claims.claim: LaLiga debut 25 September 2018: full 90 minutes in SD Eibar 1-0 away win over Espanyol
claims.note: Stated on the LaLiga page.

claims.claim: Chelsea signed him from Brighton & Hove Albion on a six-year contract
claims.note: Chelsea page: 'from Brighton & Hove Albion', 'six-year contract'. Signing year not stated, and the article does not give one.

claims.claim: Left Chelsea for Real Madrid after four successful seasons at Stamford Bridge
claims.note: Chelsea summer review states four successful seasons.

claims.claim: Real Madrid announced the agreement on 15 June 2026
claims.note: Both pages are dated 15 June 2026.

claims.claim: Contract runs to 30 June 2032, six seasons; club statement 'will join our club for the next six seasons, until June 30, 2032'
claims.note: The Peninsula quotes the club statement with the exact wording 'will join our club for the next six seasons, until June 30, 2032'. The earlier review note was out of date.

claims.claim: Quoted line: 'Real Madrid and Chelsea have reached an agreement for the transfer of the player Marc Cucurella'
claims.note: Exact wording appears in The Peninsula.

claims.claim: LaLiga transfer summary lists his signing with Yan Diomande, Bernardo Silva, Konate, Dumfries and Carlos Espi; new players arrived earlier than expected, not waiting for the final days
claims.note: Names confirmed. The source says reinforcements 'arrived ahead of schedule' and the club 'didn't leave things until the final days'. The article's 'because' framing is a light paraphrase but is supported.

claims.claim: AFP fee: 'a fee reported to be EUR 55 million (US$63.8 million)'
claims.note: Quote and figures match. NST mentions no add-ons, consistent with the article.

claims.claim: Fabrizio Romano: base fee EUR 55 million and EUR 5 million add-ons
claims.note: Matches the Hard Tackle article.

claims.claim: GeoSuper: initial EUR 55 million, further EUR 5 million performance-related add-ons; Real Madrid did not disclose financial details
claims.note: Matches. GeoSuper says nothing about Chelsea's disclosure, and the article does not claim it does.

claims.claim: No official fee published (Real Madrid did not disclose)
claims.note: Supported for Real Madrid only, and the article limits the claim accordingly.

claims.claim: Real Madrid 4-1 Real Sociedad on 26 August 2026; came on for Alvaro Carreras in the 45th minute
claims.note: Score, date and substitution confirmed.

claims.claim: Started 4-0 win over Malaga four days later
claims.note: Match dated 30 August 2026, 4-0, Cucurella among starters. Four days after 26 August is correct.

claims.claim: LaLiga club stats: 10 matches, 6 starts, 4 as substitute, 655 minutes, 390 passes; no cut-off date
claims.note: Figures match. The page gives no date range, which the article notes.

claims.claim: El Clasico 25 October 2026: Real Madrid 2-1 Barcelona; four fouls in first 38 minutes; two corners conceded at 61 and 83 minutes
claims.note: Score, fouls (6', 14', 32', 38') and corners (61', 83') all match.
